name: Tartine Bakery
editorialSummary: Organic ingredients provide the makings for breakfast pastries, hot pressed sandwiches & coffee.
reviews:
Came in the mid afternoon on a Weekday and there were still pastries left! Went on another time on a sunny weekend and line was out the door but line gradually moves.

The passion fruit lime coconut cake slice is SO good. Was very tempted to go back to get another. Perfect to take to Dolores park on a sunny day.

Loved their chocolate croissant - perfectly crispy on the outside with a flaky interi

I completely understand why Tartine Bakery is raved about. The morning bun was one of the best pastries I’ve ever had!

Caramelized sugar + orange zest for that hint of citrus. The texture was perfectly flaky and still soft in the middle.

The line on a Saturday morning took about 30 minutes, it  was wrapped around the block so I’d say it went pretty quickly.

Secured free two-hour street parking on Guerrero Street for a three-minute transit walk to the bakery, arriving at 8:08 AM for a pre-scheduled, prepaid 8:15 AM pickup order. The bakery was fairly busy, with some interior and exterior spaces occupied. Upon arrival, counter staff could not locate the pre-staged to-go bag on the holding racks. After cross-referencing email confirmation and register d

Local friends of ours highly recommend this place to us so we decided to give it a try. We rolled in right at 7:30 AM, and the place was already buzzing—the room went from quiet to almost full within 15 minutes. There’s a great morning energy here that makes the early wake-up call feel totally worth it. The vibe is focused but relaxed, the kind of spot where you can really settle in and enjoy the

Breakfast stop on a sunny SF Monday. Had the egg sando on a buttermilk loaf, gougere, cafe au latte and bread pudding. Loved the crusty cheese exterior with soft aerated bread of gougere. The bread pudding was a sweet fruity custardy heaven . Great egg sando too.

name: Bottega
editorialSummary: Classic Italian fare including pizza, pasta, and meat dishes are offered at this modest restaurant.
reviews:
There are restaurants that serve beautiful food, and then there are places that create an entire experience. Bottega manages to do both effortlessly.
Every plate felt thoughtful, balanced, and deeply comforting without losing refinement. From the pillowy gnocchi to the rich red sauce, delicate prosciutto, crisp salads, and perfectly executed seafood, every bite reminded us why simple Italian food

Very pretty restaurant! We went on Friday before around 11:30am. I liked the meatball appetizer, the sauce had the right amount of tang and sweet. The meatballs were moist but could’ve been looser. The sausage pizza was one of the best pizza’s I’ve had: lots of meat, right about of sauce, crust was crispy and chewy. I took a star away because of the fried calamari. Although fried light and crispy,

From our very first interaction, this restaurant exceeded our expectations. We called ahead with a large party of 11 people, plus our dogs, and were greeted with such warmth and kindness. Instead of making us feel like a challenge to accommodate, they made us feel genuinely welcome.

When we arrived, we were blown away by how beautiful the restaurant was. The décor is absolutely stunning and creat

Our waiter, Giovanni, was attentive and kind throughout the entire experience. We started with Brussels sprouts and bruschetta, which were excellent. For the main courses, we ordered gnocchi with Bolognese sauce, gnocchi with pesto, and fettuccine with vodka sauce. Everything was very flavorful, beautifully prepared, and the staff was extremely friendly and welcoming.

I love the simplicity of fettuccine done right: garlic, cream, Parmigiano Reggiano, cracked pepper, salt. It’s one of those dishes where there’s nowhere to hide, so the execution really matters.

Unfortunately, this one didn’t land at all.

I was hungry but couldn’t finish my pasta, which says a lot. The garlic didn’t taste fresh - more like garlic powder than properly sautéed garlic. The cream sa

name: Zeitgeist
editorialSummary: Craft beers & a spacious patio with picnic benches draw a lively crowd to this popular Mission spot.
reviews: Too bad this is one of the only true breweries in sf because it’s awful. They have the rudest bartenders who are always yelling and do not know how to pour a beer - especially the bartender who makes really shitty overpriced artwork for sale. I got a quart and a quarter of it was foam I understand it’s normal to have some head but when you are losing a quarter of the quart then spit in the face of

Always a fun time with friendly staff and plenty of outdoor space to host larger groups.

Big bonus if you ride a bike: they have bicycle parking right in their outdoor yard, so it's super safe and you can keep eyes on your bike the whole time you’re hanging out.

The place is nice -

Beers - Fair amount of selection of beers and all of them are fresh!

Place - First come first. You have to find a table for yourself and order the beers at the bar. Food order is through QR code and online. Once your food is ready you will receive a text and pick it up inside. And clean it when you leave.

Food - Burger is awesome! That’s a real burger!

The only downside is

5 stars for their epic drag brunch that happens every second Sunday of the month. Stoked to check out their drag bingo. The vibe is laid back and punk rock moto so expect graffiti and a rugged atmosphere with that hardcore feel but with a plethora of drink options and a dope backyard patio. We got the hard kombucha and an iced tea. Everyone seemed to enjoy their drinks. And the brunch menu, delish

This place is pure San Francisco  in the best possible way. A proper dive with a big outdoor area, it somehow manages to attract leather-clad bikers, crusty old-school locals, and middle-class millennials sipping rosé—all happily coexisting. The drinks are solid, the vibe’s decent, and it’s exactly the kind of place where you lose track of time and leave with a story. Not polished, not fancy, but

name: Cafe Réveille
editorialSummary: Coffeehouse for New American breakfast, lunch, and beverages in a modern setting.
reviews:
A friend found this while visiting a place close by. Beautiful place. Had quite a queue when came (brunch time on a Sunday) and needed to get a table.

Went with an iced americano and a yogurt, can recommend both.  Reviews were mentioning the really good coffee - coffee is good, but not as outstanding as people highlight. Still, 5 here.

Hint: No WIFI on the weekend, so not the best place to work

I never realized this place made good healthy food. It has lovely salads and dishes and lots of  vegetarian options with wifi on weekdays. There is indoor and outdoor seating.

When I’m not doing food reviews, I am posting videos about restaurants and cafes on tiktok @BayBitesNSips and when I’m not doing that, I am making handmade jewelry - I’d be so grateful if you visited my Etsy shop: MLEColors

This has become one of the best cafes in town! It’s truly a hidden gem and I absolutely love this place. The latte I ordered was the best I’ve had — I could honestly stay here all day. I’ll definitely be coming back!

PSA: No Wifi on the weekends!
The hibiscus herbal tea I had here was alright. Service was friendly. It’s a good place to work/study, with ample tables inside & out but no wifi on weekends. There’s some good food options if you’d like. Bathroom available.

This cafe has a fantastic, young, and vibrant atmosphere. The service is excellent—the staff is very attentive and welcoming.
The specialty coffee is top-tier, but definitely get here early if you want to try their pastries because they are incredible and go quickly! While the lunch menu is simple, everything is very flavorful. I highly recommend the Açaí bowl; it’s made with that delicious deep r

name: Bon, Nene
editorialSummary: Charming hideaway offering modern Japanese small plates with French accents, plus beer & wine.
reviews: I've always wanted to try Bon Nene because many friends raved about their food. Overall, I'm not disappointed! So, my first impression was that, this restaurant was popular for sure, I came here just by its open time (at 5:35pm on a Friday), but their tables were almost filled (2 groups behind were put on a waitlist - crazy). The place was small, I think like 40 max capacity. But food was served q

Even the Internet may not tell you but Bon, Nene’s wonderful Japanese breakfast is available from 10:00am only on Fridays and Saturdays!

I tried their breakfast on May 22, 2026.
The breakfast is beautifully presented, scrumptious and really healthy, which has many kinds of veggies.

The miso soup is packed with ingredients, which is great!

It’s fun to have a choice for a rice ball, or “onigiri.”

very quaint and cozy atmosphere, gets crowded quickly with a waitlist to write your name on outside. we had got there right as they opened for brunch at 12, but told they could not make about half of the items on the menu. wait time for food was overall okay, appetizers and drinks came out quickly but took a bit for us to get our entrées. many tables had received their food far before ours even th

no wait list, so on a friday night for 3 people at 6:30pm we waited 45 minutes to be seated

the food is french fusion and japanese and it was delicious! The rice bowls have a lottt of rice, which is exactly what they do in japan, but i do wish it had an extra slice or two of fish >

The ambience at Bon Nene is truly amazing; it is a beautifully curated space that immediately sets a great tone for the meal. The service is equally impressive, with staff who are attentive and welcoming, doing a fantastic job of making you feel well-cared for from the moment you walk in.
Unfortunately, the food does not quite live up to the high standard set by the atmosphere. Overall, the meal f

name: In-N-Out Burger
editorialSummary: Classic burger chain serving customizable burgers, hand-cut fries & shakes.
reviews: Highly recommend this In-N-Out near the pier! It was super crowded and chaotic, but totally worth it. Grabbed a Double-Double combo and a cheeseburger, and the self-serve free refills were a huge plus. Pro tip: definitely ask for the fries "well-done" if you want that perfect crunch! Also, don't forget to ask for grilled onions in your burger—it completely elevates the flavor and suits our taste p
The French fries were tasty.  Burgers was good.  A lot of people, hard to find a place to park and sit.  But the line moves fast.  Also we got some stickers from workers there. I appreciate it.

Crazy how the shop opens at 1030 am and the queue starts to build up

Good quality burgers with fresh ingredients
Reasonably priced

Overall good place to satisfy a burger cravings

However during lunch and dinner times the queue can get crazy. I was here the day before and didnt even bother trying to queue

Limited seats in this outlets as well
So it’s advisable to come early or do a take out

Super busy location as expected, but efficient staff and good burgers. It was my first time trying in-n-out while I had a stop over in San Francisco, and I’m glad I came by. Food was good, but not as good as the hype says it is. It’s a burger, well made, but nothing special. The fries is where the real gem is. Animal style fries are so good. Definitely recommend trying but don’t expect to be blown

People rave about it so gave it a try, it was fine but nothing I'd probably I'd write home about.  Very small too and I ordered the biggest they had. Place was packed, a row of seats for those waiting but not enough for the huge amount of people coming & going. It wasn't as fast as I wouldve thought but they were under the pump.
Have had far nicer burgers elsewhere but its all personal preference

name: The Midway
reviews: I really like the midway venue. I've seen Griz and Deadmau5 there on separate occasions. It's nice that they have multiple bars so waiting for a drink doesn't take too long. They also have a decent amount of restrooms so the lines don't get too overwhelming. I also like how they have other extra rooms you can go sit if you need a break. Both the outdoor and indoor sound is really clear and the pro

Love this venue when traveling to SF. Only thing id like to see, are some fans hung (maybe 1 in each corner?) In the venue creating better airflow. 4 fans could be funded from 1 nights revenue and would make a huge difference in crowd comfort for the warmer days.

I went to a sold-out concert (Botas Y Rave) on June 6th 2026,  and they only had 12 porta potties outside for the 3,500-4,000 people in attendance.. My friends and i spent half the concert in line, waiting for the restroom. Horrible planning by the organizers and venue..

The Chase Experience is at the Midway for a one day event to help small businesses. They brought in some small businesses to provide food. They offered small business owners information on Chase Banking for businesses as well as insight into the economy and skills to help them grow their business.
Very nice event for small business networking and to share community in the SF Bay Area!
Wonderful venue even when it’s packed there seemed to be a decent air flow. Plenty of bars short lines and friendly staff from what I experienced. 10/10 would visit again

name: Holy Water
editorialSummary: Relaxed tavern pouring classic cocktails & craft beers in a rustic space with religious decor.
reviews: Come here and give your prayers to Holy Church. 🙏😜. Great neighborhood bar. Great atmosphere. Great selection of drinks with religious inspired names. Great place for a Friday happy hour after work with good company 😉

The best bar in the city. Such a fantastic local bar. The bartenders are incredibly welcoming and make some of the best cocktails ever. The agave selection w/ the huge bourbon selection is top notch. Highly recommend this to all the spirit connoisseurs!
The beer is delicious, and the atmosphere is unique, which I really liked. I also liked the area.

Stopped into Holy Water in San Francisco to meet a friend before dinner, and it was perfect. We grabbed seats at the bar and could easily catch up — not loud at all, just a relaxed neighborhood vibe. It definitely seems like a local favorite; as we were heading out, we passed at least four dogs, and a couple even had their own dog beds.

I didn’t check out the beer list (not even sure if they have

A favorite always! I used to live in the neighborhood but will always come back and hang at Holy Water. They put so much thought into their cocktails, tap list, decor, menus, glassware — it’s just a whole moody vibe and they continue to get better as time goes on.

name: Starbucks Coffee Company
address: Letterman Digital Arts Center, 1 Letterman Dr, San Francisco, CA 94129
editorialSummary: Welcoming coffeehouse with handcrafted coffee, espresso & tea, plus breakfast, lunch & pastries.
reviews: Shout out to Starbucks Presidio!! Junmare is always my sunshine everyday! He is very fast, very friendly and very attentive! I worked at Philz Coffee for many years and I have to say their service is amazing here :) Junmare and Ryan always nail their drinks every single time I order! Thank you so much for being so kind and helpful every time including those whom I don’t get to catch their names. T

I keep making the mistake of going to Starbucks when I already know I don’t like it, but this time around I felt obligated to use a Starbucks gift card I got from a relative. Free food, right? At least, it should be free, with how low quality it is.

There is always that wave of regret that washes over you when you take your first bite into an awful piece of fast food. That’s how I felt when I sun
Starbucks is located in a quiet and secluded place. I like that the drinks taste the same no matter where you go. The staff were friendly.

Favorite Starbucks locay! Absolutely love the location and views from here. The outdoor seating area is beautiful and the access to this Starbucks is lovely too. Always our go-to coffee fix whenever we're around the Golden Gate. You can see the palace of fine arts from here! And the cafe isn't usually crowded like the other ones.

A very not in your face starbucks. Quite hidden. Lots of seating inside and outside patio. First time there was a lot of washrooms actually. 2 stalls on the women's side. Lots of packaged options like legume and egg options, variety of sandwiches as well as all the usual stuff.

name: Panera Bread
editorialSummary: Counter-serve bakery/cafe chain serving sandwiches, salads & more, known for its bread & free WiFi.
reviews: I was so shocked when I got this breakfast sandwich at this very small size of it I mean, I didn’t want a big huge breakfast burrito size sandwich, but the little skimpy half that I got for $8  was laughable. I guess it could also be because I asked for sourdough. I sat there and laughed a few times because it was the size of a toddlers breakfast, and I suppose I could’ve just went to McDonalds. T
We had dinner here tonight. The service and food were good. The prices are fairly reasonable. The tables needed cleaned, however, overall it was a good experience.

Today was an awful experience at this Panera location. 6/29/26 630pm No ice at the fountain drink area. The men's restroom is out of order apparently. The food was really bad today. I ordered over 30 dollars worth of food and regretted it. I typically go to the location on the north side of town and have never had an issue with the food, atmosphere, or service. The thin hispanic lady with glasses

I was driving home after being awake and out early on a Saturday morning.  Very early.  Since I had nothing more planned to do and I was hungry.  I wanted an egg and cheese sandwich and a hot tea.  I thought I would go to Panera Bread, so I entered my request into Google Maps.
When I arrived, there were ultimately zero customers inside other than one man with a cell phone charging.
The building wa

8/26
I'm struggling with my choice to pick Panera as one of my places to frequent for lunch. Maybe I'll try another location next time. Sadly, employees must not be trained to at least cut the brown part off of the avocado. 😔 It was actually not ripe and I could not cut it with just the fork. Disappointing.
It was still a tasty salad though. Next time maybe dine-in so I can address it then vs dri

name: IHOP
address: 644 N First St, San Jose, CA 95112
editorialSummary: Long-standing chain serving a wide variety of pancakes & other American breakfast & diner fare.
reviews: The best thing about this place is that they’re open 24 hours! I would definitely recommend it, especially when everything else is closed. The pricing is reasonable, and the service was excellent. Pamela helped our table and was great from the start. She was very patient with us and offered helpful recommendations. She checked on us frequently and went the extra mile to make sure everything was ex

WOW!!!!! What a fabulous experience! We were seated right away by Celeste, who by the way, had a big warm smile that greated us. She served our food quickly.... AND WHAT A SURPRISE! Our food looked better than the pictures on the menu! And it tasted even better! Big changes have happened here and we will be back. Thank you to Celeste and all of the team for a delicious cheerful breakfast! My only
This is the best fried steak I’ve ever had! And the place is cozy.
The food is excellent and the service is terrific.  Very friendly staff.
Tried and true. Great breakfast, fast and friendly service. Clean restrooms and typical diner atmosphere.

name: Jack's
address: 167 E Taylor St, San Jose, CA 95112
editorialSummary: Down-to-earth bar catering to regulars from the neighborhood with DJs and beer pong.
reviews:
Wonderfully family owned business, where the bartenders know their drinks, staff is quick in keeping grounds clean and an amazing community fun space especially for sports games and hosting events! We had our high school reunion there!

As far as food, you can easily order from Spread (sandwiches) or Jtown pizza and are allowed to bring outside food in too!

Spent a well deserved catch up session with one of my best friends.  Jacks is such a great place to hang out, service is great and drinks are even better!  Located in the heart of Japantown makes it a place everyone should visit!

I had a terrible experience watching an Arsenal match there.

This is supposed to be an Arsenal supporters club, yet they allow fans of rival teams like Manchester United and Manchester City to come in during Arsenal games. Not only that, they were openly laughing, mocking, and disrespecting Arsenal fans when we conceded goals.

That’s completely unacceptable for a supporters club.

I’ve been to S

I will say food quality here is above average.

Portion is big but lacking in flavor.

We order non alcohol drink , one appetizer and two of main fishes total around $90

I have been coming here for years and have had all amazing experiences until last night. My friends and I came in on Saturday around 11 and the bar was busy. There wasn’t much space and a woman turned to me and was aggravated I bumped into her in a busy bar. I replied that unfortunately that was the nature of a dive bar to which she grabbed her drink and threw it in my face. Mind you it was an alc

name: Starbucks Coffee Company
editorialSummary: Welcoming coffeehouse with handcrafted coffee, espresso & tea, plus breakfast, lunch & pastries.
reviews:
Whoever made my drink this morning, DESERVES A RAISE!! I usually get 5 shots of espresso, iced lightly with a few syrups. The smaller the cup, the happier I am. This morning's barista understood the assignment! ❤️
Other baristas tend to give me usual amount of ice and in a venti cup. LOVE this Starbucks particularly!!

Extremely poor experience! Not classy at all. I came in on 2/23/26 at 6:30 pm after a Pilates workout across the street’ for a cup of ice water, & was rudely greeted by a lady with pink hair stating water is only with purchases I’ve never heard of this before in any other Starbucks I have been to. Regardless I did not mind making a purchase however, her form of expression, rude tone, and body lang

Friendly Baristas and prompt service. Bathrooms cleaned. Seating was a little crowded when I was there but I dod get a seat. Parking can be a challenge. Street parking and a lot across the street. Had to walk a block to get here.

Plenty of tables, both indoor and out. You can be sure to always see people studying here. Every table I've ever sat at has an outlet nearby, which immediately makes this place better than most libraries I've been to!

Their staff always seems super friendly and parking is never a problem. Best part of this Starbucks? I believe they're open until 11 for those of you who need a late night coffee or

Good coffee
Fast service
Great people
Amazing place with great wifi
Love this place because it is in the heart of willow glen downtown - not far from the library if you want get a book at read it
Have great sitting area

name: Foodmaxx
editorialSummary: Warehouse-like, discount supermarket chain with familiar offerings, such as meat & produce.
reviews: Rude employee at the self checkout section with condescending tone. Acted like a security guard as we entered the store. Wanted to remove an item from the self check out list. Was first to report for assistance yet was last to get assisted. Biggest issue was their machines make you put items in the bagging section to avoid theft. I always press skip bagging and put my items in my cart. He yelled a

This is a unique store. Its a grocery store with a wearhouse feel. The aisles are well stocked, clean, and there was a wider range of products than the typical Lucky or Safeway. This was my first visit to the store, and was surprised to see a bunch of Asian and Latino grandma types crowded around a display of leggings near the produce section. I guess it was a really good deal, there seemed to be

I wanted to do some grocery shopping today.  Im a disabled senior and this Foodmaxx doesn't provide scooters for the disabled.  Spoke with the 'Mgr'  he stated they do not purchase the scooters anymore due to theft.   I said thats the cost of doing business.  Write them off at the end of the year.  Basically I'm being discriminated because of my disability!  Foodmaxx how much money are you loosing

When buying products and have expiration. And wanting to exchange or so. Should be able to do it without receipt especially if bought with card.

HAVE YOUR WORKERS CHECK EXPIRATION ON ALL ITEMS

I’m a loyal FoodMaxx customer and appreciate how friendly and professional the cashiers are whenever I shop here. They consistently provide good service despite the store often being busy.  Overall, I value this location and the team’s efforts.

name: Chick-fil-A
editorialSummary: Fast-food chain serving chicken sandwiches & nuggets along with salads & sides.
reviews: Food was good, fresh and hot. We dined in and it seemed to take a long time before our order was brought to the table. Hordes of delivery people waiting by the counter. Ketchup is in clever packages but were more difficult to open than it should be. A worker was doing a great job scrubbing tables, sweeping up. No problem getting a refill on drinks. It has a play place for kids!
Paid extra for Tomato to add in the sandwich got all the way home ready to eat and they forgot to add🥺💔🥺💔

Like always the customer service was absolutely amazing. As a whole the chicken sandwiches are above average but the sauces are the best around. Every time you thank a staff member they respond with “my pleasure” I love it. The shakes are also great I recommend the strawberry one.

Food was great as usual but “Dining Room Closed Due to Staff Shortages” on a 90 degree day at 6pm. Counted at least 18 team members on the clock not including people in the back on fryers or on break. There were more staff telling people the dining room was closed than would be necessary to clean the tables and run the food. Oddest experience I’ve ever had at a Chick-fil-A. Open to take your money

I genuinely love Chick-fil-A. I eat here often, and most locations are consistent, friendly, and reliable. That’s exactly why this one is so frustrating.

This Monterey Rd location constantly forgets the sauces I clearly select in my order. Not once. Not twice. It’s become a pattern. At this point, I almost expect to open my bag and find dry nuggets and sandwiches staring back at me.

It might sou

name: Starbucks Coffee Company
editorialSummary: Welcoming coffeehouse with handcrafted coffee, espresso & tea, plus breakfast, lunch & pastries.
reviews: They are extremely disrespectful and I sat at the register waiting for someone to take my order and I saw them for like a minute straight and they clearly saw me and they were even at the other register giving the other people their food but then they just walked away and there’s like four of them behind the counter and you also have to pay to get into the bathroom?? also they are so petty that th

A awesome Friday at this store, I was started by a Caramel Crmfr without coffee. I love this store while because they make drinks so details such as their drinks. I always come here when my free time appears on weeks! Few times a week :))

My favorite drinks are hot chocolate for fall, cold drinks like crmfr for summer, and all teas for winter with hot. Those are awesome and amazing for all of you

When I need a hot coffee and fast, this is my go to location, even though there is another location down the street I always pick this one for its friendly staff, clean lobby and fast service plus they always make my drink correctly.

The employees need to get their attitude in check. Came back just to see if they could remake my drinks that tasted like nothing and I got attitude and bs explanation of why they tasted like nothing and got an attitude from a white boy with long hair.

Can definitely do better since I didn't give no attitude or caused any drama.
The cafe has a lot of space to do work or chill.

name: Habit Burger & Grill
editorialSummary: Charbroiled burgers star at this fast-food chain also offering deli-type sandwiches, salads & fries.
reviews:
$10 dollar special!
This is my 3rd location I visit. The taste is the same and the quality is a 5 star. The restrooms are nice and clean and the staff is doing a great job. Come try the special guys!

My first time back since it opened. Husband and I stopped here for lunch today at the request of our granddaughters. He and I had their $10 meal deal and it was just perfect. It was a half sandwich burger, with, 5 pc chicken, my choice of a selected sides and a medium drink. Perfect. And delicious. What a wonderful blessing. Thank you Habit. We will come again.

Whether you eat in or take home, best bang for your buck is the Family CharBox at $35 bucks where you get 4 burgers and 4 fries.  Burgers were hot and juicy with cool crispy lettuce, tomato and pickles.  Fries were hot and crispy, we swapped 1 fries for the tempura green beans for .80 cents, which were all hot and crispy.

Ordered online and picked up in person. Staff was really friendly, food was great as always, with one exception - THERE WAS NO CHEESE ON MAH CHEEZBURGER!!! Mildly frustrating, but overall Habit is awesome as always. Just please don't forget my cheese again. 😄

My kids like the burger here. The milk shake was a bit too sweet to me, but the kids like them. I like that they have sweet potatoes fries, and It was good but not so crunchy comparing to their regular fries. My sister ordered the cauliflower grilled, it was ok, a bit too soft for my taste and even it was grilled but was kinda oily.

name: Panera Bread
editorialSummary: Counter-serve bakery/cafe chain serving sandwiches, salads & more, known for its bread & free WiFi.
reviews: 09.16.25 9:30am Italian Steak and Mozzarella Sandwich comes with Kettle Potato Chips $13.69 and Hazelnut Coffees $3.89.  Very fresh, hot and super delicious!  Soups are only served at lunch so we missed those :(

Absolute ripoff. Small portions.

Look at my soup and tell me it’s worth $6.39 + tax. It’s small and has almost no solids. $16.06 for a tiny soup and salad? No thanks. And they have the gall to ask for a tip? Absurd.

Panera has gone downhill and their meals have little value when compared to the other fast casual options out there. Sadly, I won’t be coming back. I’m disappointed for the last time

Very dissappinting! The restaurant was extremely dirty, none of the tables or chairs, either inside or outside, seemed to be cleaned. There was a very unpleasant smell inside, and the food quality was very poor. The sandwich was poorly made, messy, and falling apart. Even the container it was served in was dirty. The fruit on the side was spoiled. Overall, the food tasted bad and did not meet expe

We were in the area and decided to try this place. They have ample parking and when entering posters with a very varied menu. The very attentive cashier helped us choose. We ordered soups and sandwiches. they give you a locator. The decoration is a bit old. We sat at a table by the window, it didn't take long for them to call us, we have to look for the order in the cooks' area. My French onion so

Very first time coming here and I’m pleasantly surprised of how good the experience was. It was cold today and I’m glad I ran into this place. I got a classic grilled cheese with chicken noodle soup. I’m vary happy with my meal and I’ll be back to try more . The Costomer service was also very attentive and friendly.plenty if parking and tons of seating inside .

name: Starbucks Coffee Company
editorialSummary: Welcoming coffeehouse with handcrafted coffee, espresso & tea, plus breakfast, lunch & pastries.
reviews:
It’s not a big store, but it has plenty of tables and chairs. I love the decoration here; the pictures and art on the wall give it a very artistic vibe.

It was very crowded when I arrived, so I had to wait for over 15 minutes. Unfortunately, my drink was taken by someone else, but the staff quickly apologized and remade it for me. I ordered an Ice Protein Matcha (No Classic Syrup, 2 packets of St

I want to sincerely thank Dylan, Lauren, and Jay for their warm and friendly service. They have always been welcoming and kind whenever we visit this Starbucks.

Today, I accidentally left an important bag behind, and they kindly kept it safe for me. It truly helped me so much and gave me great peace of mind. 🙏

name: Five Guys
editorialSummary: Fast-food chain with made-to-order burgers, fries & hot dogs, plus free peanuts while you wait.
reviews: How is a cheese hot dog $10? The prices were really high for what it was. The fries were fried in peanut oil, and although it’s real food, it was very salty. I don’t see the appeal of five guys when there is in and out down the street.

Five guys is a great place for burgers! They are fresh and made to order. I recommend the little bacon burger and bacon burger.  Their bacon is wonderfully crisp.

Personal preference... I don't like American cheese, so when I get home, I melt cheddar on my burger. If you like American cheese, the little bacon cheeseburger is the way to go.
